costs.creation: O(1) generic reservation/backing/range/value-handle allocations and code-residency bookkeeping, one native query and one independent native AddRef; no element array copy
costs.assignmentAndParameters: retain the existing owning language carrier; no element copy
costs.slice: O(1) checked range handle/value allocation and backing-owner retain; no element copy or new native indexed query
costs.index: bounds and schema check, one resident read scope, one POD value copy; no native element query or boxing
costs.foreach: one resident traversal scope, direct typed C array reads and POD loop values; no per-element allocation, boxing or native element query
costs.cleanup: actual owning native release when the last relevant backing owner retires; deferred/failed cleanup follows the shared runtime protocol
